_comment: Phase 0 checkpoint rulings overlay (owner ruling, 2026-08-04). Consumed by join.js: merged into decisions-queue.json by decision id. Never edited by any parser or the join logic itself — hand-authored, re-read every run. See tools/extract/REWRITE-SPEC.md file layout and PLAN.md §9.3/§9.6.

D0-003.resolvedTo: Owner ruling 2026-08-04: link during Phase 1 — rewriters apply the two substitution rules meal-by-meal where each condition holds (rapeseed for pan heat, olive for finishing; sweetheart cabbage where little gem is only shredded); reviewer verifies each application.

D0-030.resolvedTo: Owner ruling 2026-08-04: keep the truncation heuristic (comma/paren truncation for name.canonical) as implemented in join.js; revisit only if Phase 2 search needs more.

D0-031.resolvedTo: Owner ruling 2026-08-04: sku.verifiedOn stays null at extraction time; it is populated only by real price-check events recorded through LIST's verify flow (§5 runtime state priceChecks), never backfilled from a file date or extraction timestamp.

confirmedDefaults.note: Every decisions-queue.json entry with status 'resolved-by-default' that is NOT named in `rulings` above was skim-reviewed and confirmed AS-IS by the owner at the 2026-08-04 Phase 0 checkpoint — no changes, no overturns. join.js stamps resolvedBy on these entries the same way it does for the explicit rulings above, recording the confirmation. confirmedCount is a self-check: join.js STOPs if the actual count of such entries in decisions-queue.json ever drifts from this number, since that would mean the checkpoint's confirmation no longer covers the full queue and the owner needs to re-review.
